verdict.rationale: Granola has a RESTful API and workspace API keys that give programmatic access to meeting notes, transcripts and AI summaries. It also has an official MCP server for searching and querying notes. The documented scope is read and integration access to note data only, far short of UI parity. Many UI capabilities have no documented API equivalent: templates, recipes, Chat workflows (sending email or Slack, creating calendar events), sharing and folders, transcript auto-deletion settings, and recording or capture. No public OpenAPI spec was found (all probe paths returned 404). Missing for 10: API coverage of note creation and recording, templates and recipes, Chat actions, sharing and folder management, settings and admin controls, a published API reference or OpenAPI spec, and independent confirmation of API breadth.
